quarterly_data.quarter: Advanced Energy press release: Advanced Energy Unveils Centra Smart Hub for Improved (10-13-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Advanced Energy launched the Centra Smart Hub at SEMICON West: a centralized hub supporting up to eight of its new Remote Smart Sensors (RSS) for non-contact wafer-temperature measurement and real-time temperature control in lamp-heated Si and SiC thermal processes such as rapid thermal annealing (RTA) and epitaxial (Epi) growth in semiconductor equipment. The company claims industry-leading performance with up to a 40% improvement in accuracy over other standard solutions when measuring at 3.3 um or 5.2 um and at temperatures up to 1700°C; the hub has embedded ECAT and Ethernet protocols, and the RSS mount directly on the chamber in ambient temperatures up to 60°C. EVP Plasma Power Juergen Braun: the hub 'enables temperature measurement for Si and SiC processes to help fabs improve wafer-to-wafer repeatability and thermal uniformity for higher yields.'
quarterly_data.figure: up to eight sensors per hub; up to a 40% improvement in accuracy (company claim); measurement at 3.3 um or 5.2 um; temperatures up to 1700°C
